research_notes: A later failure classifier should distinguish application/tool rejection from infrastructure unavailability and elapsed-runtime termination.
Only the latter category is directly relevant to the runtime boundary unless the application rejection prevents required close evidence.
Even then, the cause should be documented rather than mislabeled as timeout.
This sample demonstrates why explicit failure taxonomy matters in long tool-heavy turns.
The strict boundary remains unresolved until a credible duration-related failure occurs.
The current target remains 14m pending close.
